subject: Hospitality
title: Ghost Kitchens and Virtual Brands
description: A quick win: understand Ghost Kitchens and Virtual Brands.

hook.text: Ghost kitchens have no dining room, no front-of-house staff, and no walk-in guests. They cook exclusively for delivery apps.

buildup.text: One physical kitchen can house multiple 'virtual brands'—different menus, different names.

discovery.text: Ghost kitchens cut rent costs by 50–70% compared to traditional restaurants. No dining room means no expensive real estate.

twist.text: Hotels are launching ghost kitchen brands from existing kitchens. Idle capacity between meal periods generates delivery revenue.

climax.text: The model's weakness: no atmosphere, no service, no loyalty. Food must compete on taste alone—which favors established.

punchline.text: No tables, no waiters, no storefront. Ghost kitchens trade experience for efficiency.

quiz.question: Why do ghost kitchens save on costs?
options: No dining room means 50–70% less rent compared to traditional restaurants
